#: False binds every tool_choice as auto, for ForceVerdictOnly's working calls.
# langchain_anthropic drops tool_choice for thinking type `enabled` AND `adaptive`, but
# only manual `enabled` is restricted to auto/none -- adaptive accepts tool/any
# (thinking.md, "Thinking with tool use"), which is what via:sdk's _forcing_blocked
# encodes. Without this the outcome tool is merely advertised, so any S2/S4/S6 session
# can end on prose and lose its structured output.
